comment: Plan 036 WP-0's reviewed inert list (tier-2 data; plan036_wp0/scan.py). A target here touches nothing outside the process's memory. Keyed by fully qualified target, or (types) by class for a closed set of in-memory types whose every method is inert. A wrong entry hides an edge: that is the residual the plan names.

types.reason: a value json.loads/json.load produced (dict, list, str, int, float, bool or None), proved by plan036_wp0/json_origin.py: every method of those types is in-memory
immutable text: every method computes in memory
immutable bytes: every method computes in memory
a mutable byte buffer in memory; no method reaches outside the process
a view of an in-memory buffer
integers: arithmetic and formatting only
floats: arithmetic and formatting only
booleans: arithmetic and formatting only
an in-memory container; element protocol calls are classified at their own sites
an in-memory container; key hashing of repository types is scanned in the repository
an in-memory container
an immutable in-memory container
an immutable in-memory container
an arithmetic sequence
an iterator adaptor over an iterable classified where it was produced
an iterator adaptor over iterables classified where they were produced
an iterator adaptor; the mapped callable is classified where it is referenced
an iterator adaptor over an in-memory sequence
exception objects: construction, str() and repr() are in-memory (subclasses inherit these methods)
a compiled regular expression: matching is in-memory
a regular-expression match result
a hash object: update() and hexdigest() compute in memory
an in-memory XML element tree; no method parses a file or resolves an entity
builds an element tree in memory from events it is fed
pure path arithmetic: no PurePath method touches the filesystem (Path methods that do are declared edges)
an in-memory multiset
an immutable UUID value
an immutable IP address value
an immutable IP network value
enum flag arithmetic
the fields of a stat result already obtained by a declared call
fields of a directory entry already obtained by a declared scandir; DirEntry.stat is listed as a declared edge, not here
a context manager that swallows the named exceptions
an in-process re-entrant lock
an abstract protocol: the concrete mapping was produced by a call or module read classified where it happened
an abstract protocol: the concrete mapping was produced by a call or module read classified where it happened
an abstract protocol: the concrete set was produced by a call classified where it happened
operations on an archive object whose construction is a declared edge (constructor sites are declared, not inert)
close/enter/exit of a stream whose opening is a declared edge, or an in-memory buffer
reads from a stream whose opening is a declared edge, or an in-memory buffer
an in-memory byte stream
enter/exit of a temporary directory whose creation is a declared edge
context management of a directory iterator whose creation (os.scandir) is a declared edge
rows of a query whose execution (sqlite3.Connection.execute) is a declared edge
date arithmetic and formatting (no method of date reads the clock; date.today is not used)

targets.reason: Constructors and functions of built-in types that compute in memory
Exception classes: constructing one is in-memory
Attribute access by a literal name: the attribute itself is resolved and classified separately (a computed name is unresolvable)
Decorators and class machinery that define, not run, code
Writes to the process's own standard streams: an output, never an input the lane depends on
Typing helpers that are identity functions or introspection at run time
Dataclass helpers: copy and introspect in memory
Codecs and serialisers over in-memory values
Process-global but in-memory: the ElementTree namespace prefix table
Regular expressions: compiled and matched in memory
stat mode tests on a mode already obtained by a declared call
Date and time values computed from their arguments (datetime.now, which reads the clock, is a declared edge)
Pure path construction; Path.cwd and Path.absolute read the process's working directory, which the runner fixes (the repository root) and the record states, and reach no file
Command-line parsing of the launch argv, which the record states
Logging with no handler configured anywhere in a lane process (no basicConfig, FileHandler or dictConfig is reached): the last-resort handler writes to stderr
Type aliases built at import by typing's own __or__/__getitem__ on classes and typing objects (X = A | B, X = Literal[...]): in-memory
